scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Peco Pecos?
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
你猎杀够50只大嘴鸟了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放弃

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
嗯，你好像还没猎杀够50只...

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Please hurry and kill 50 of those tasty err pesky Peco Pecos.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
快去解决掉50只美味的...呃，讨厌的大嘴鸟吧。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
确定要放弃狩猎吗？
目前的任务进度都会清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
好吧，改变主意了就回来找我。

scripts.text:

Please hurry and kill 50 of those tasty err pesky Peco Pecos.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Oh thank you so much!
I think that I can rest easily now.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
哦，太谢谢你了！
这下我总算能安心休息了。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Peco Pecos are fascinating.
I am still doing my, uh, research...
But now it is of a different nature.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
大嘴鸟真有意思。
我还在做，呃，“研究”...不过现在研究方向变了。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
You see I've been uh, ''researching''
these animals by collecting their
Bill of Birds but lately they seem
to have become hostile towards me.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
我一直收集它们的鸟喙，借此...呃，“研究”这些动物。
可是最近，它们好像开始敌视我了。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Can you do me a favor please?
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
能帮我个忙吗？

scripts.text: What kind of favor?
scripts.translation: 什么样的忙

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
I am so afraid that these Peco Pecos will hurt me for my, uh, researching activities.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
我真怕这些大嘴鸟会因为我的，呃，研究活动而报复我。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Can you help protect me by killing them?
I think I'll feel safer...
Please...
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
能帮我杀掉它们，保护我吗？
这样我就能安心些...拜托了...

scripts.text:

Thank you so much.

非常感谢你。

scripts.text:

This is gonna be delicious!

这一定会很好吃！

看来你带来的还不够。

scripts.text:

Ah, ok I think you can help me out by hunting some Peco Pecos.
How many would you like to hunt?
scripts.translation:

好，那就帮我猎杀些大嘴鸟吧。
你打算猎杀多少只？
